items.statement: 最终：论文支持的连续路线与 dibenzo[a,o]picene 产物
items.expected: The final selected route connects first closure, intervening aromatization/oxidation, second closure and final aromatization in the paper-supported sequence, and explicitly selects a generated product with dibenzo[a,o]picene connectivity. Require mapped, atom- and hydrogen-accounted sequential calculation evidence. Both the supported sequence and the correct final product selection are required for this combined item; merely listing the product while selecting another or remaining undecided is insufficient. This is a bounded endpoint/electronic selectivity explanation, not proof of excited-state kinetics; additional TS/IRC, iodine calculations and optical/device properties are not required.
